questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 In the context of service design, why is it important to understand the relationships between service receivers and service providers?
options: To create personalized solutions for each individual user.
To ensure that brands can deliver on expectations optimally and sustainably.
To make the design process more complicated.
To ensure that service providers are prioritized over service receivers.
questions.correct_answer: To ensure that brands can deliver on expectations optimally and sustainably.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 How do Agile and Design Thinking complement each other when used together?
options: Design Thinking helps identify the right problems to solve, and Agile helps build solutions iteratively.
Design Thinking focuses on the development process, while Agile focuses on user needs.
Agile emphasizes problem-finding, while Design Thinking emphasizes problem-solving.
Agile replaces the need for Design Thinking in the development process
questions.correct_answer: Design Thinking helps identify the right problems to solve, and Agile helps build solutions iteratively.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following steps taken by Netflix would be the best example of human-centric design to improve its user experience?

By adding short trailers to its interface.
By partnering with traditional networks to acquire content.
By creating a subscription model for DVDs.
questions.correct_answer: By adding short trailers to its interface.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 What is the primary purpose of creating personas in design thinking?
options: To represent different user types that might use your service or product similarly.
To create a set of stock photos for marketing materials.
To make assumptions about user behaviour.
To assign names and demographics to potential users.
questions.correct_answer: To represent different user types that might use your service or product similarly.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 When conducting interviews during the Empathize phase, what is one way to get deeper and more personalized insights?
options: Ask smart, researched questions
Observe how the end user is interacting with their surroundings
Record the interview with whatever tools you have
Choose experts with varying points of view
questions.correct_answer: Observe how the end user is interacting with their surroundings

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statements best describes the role of legal codes, regulations, and social and political contexts in the design process?
options: They should be ignored to prioritize aesthetics and innovation.
They shape design decisions by imposing constraints and requirements.
They have no impact on the design process.
They only apply to specific industries and products.
questions.correct_answer: They shape design decisions by imposing constraints and requirements.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 In the design thinking process, what is the purpose of identifying the "point of view" of the user?
options: To brainstorm potential solutions to the problem.
To develop a detailed project plan with clear objectives.
To understand the user's perspective and empathize with their needs.
To analyze data and create a data-driven problem statement.
questions.correct_answer: To understand the user's perspective and empathize with their needs.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 When writing a "How Might We" statement, what should the "desired effect" represent?

The expected outcome or benefit for the user.
The insight gained from user research.
questions.correct_answer: The expected outcome or benefit for the user.

By creating a new type of container that was more decorative than functional

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Penicillin was discovered by Scottish biologist Alexander Fleming in 1928. Reverse Engineering
Patent Infringement
Innovation and Serendipity
questions.correct_answer: Innovation and Serendipity

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 What is the main advantage of a more systematic approach to innovation?

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statements best describes big picture thinking?

Considering the broader context and long-term implications of actions and decisions
Ignoring the impact of actions and decisions on the broader context and long- term consequences
questions.correct_answer: Considering the broader context and long-term implications of actions and decisions
